source: ASCE 7-22 Sec 4.7 (reduction of uniform live loads), Sec 4.8.2 (roofs)

sources.influenceMin: ASCE 7-22 Sec 4.7.2: members with KLL AT of 400 ft² (37.16 m²) or more
sources.minOneFloor: ASCE 7-22 Sec 4.7.2: at least 0.50 L0 for members supporting one floor, 0.40 L0 for two or more
sources.heavyLive: ASCE 7-22 Sec 4.7.3: live loads over 100 psf (4.79 kN/m²) not reduced, except 20 % on members supporting two or more floors
sources.notReduced: ASCE 7-22 Sec 4.7.5: live loads of 100 psf or less not reduced in assembly uses
sources.twoFloorsOnly: ASCE 7-22 Sec 4.7.4: passenger vehicle garages not reduced, except 20 % on members supporting two or more floors
sources.oneWaySlabWidth: ASCE 7-22 Sec 4.7.6: AT of a one-way slab at most 1.5 times the span squared
sources.kll: ASCE 7-22 Table 4.7-1, live load element factor KLL
sources.roof: ASCE 7-22 Sec 4.8.2, Eq 4.8-1: Lr = L0 R1 R2, 12 psf <= Lr <= 20 psf (0.58-0.96 kN/m²); R1 = 1 (AT <= 200 ft²), 1.2 - 0.001 AT (ft²), 0.6 (AT >= 600 ft²); R2 = 1 (F <= 4), 1.2 - 0.05 F, 0.6 (F >= 12), F the rise in inches per foot (0.12 x the slope in per cent), 32 x rise/span for an arch or dome
